categories.name: Produce & Forage Shipped
categories.requirement: Ship one of every item in the Items Shipped (Farm & Forage) tab in the collections menu.

categories.name: Obelisks on Farm
categories.requirement: Build Earth Obelisk, Water Obelisk, Desert Obelisk, and Island Obelisk on the farm.

categories.name: Golden Clock on Farm
categories.requirement: Build Gold Clock on the farm.

categories.name: Monster Slayer Hero
categories.requirement: Complete all monster eradication goals for the Adventurer's Guild.

categories.name: Great Friends
categories.requirement: Reach maximum hearts with every villager. This includes Kent, so it is not possible to complete this in year 1. Note: The "maximum hearts" for datable villagers is 8, and for non-datable villagers, 10 is the max. If the player has children, their friendship status does not affect the score.

categories.name: Crafting Recipes Made
categories.requirement: Craft all items. The Wedding Ring is not required, even in Multiplayer games.

categories.name: Fish Caught
categories.requirement: Catch every fish in the Fish tab in the collections menu.

categories.name: Golden Walnuts found
categories.requirement: Find all Golden Walnuts on Ginger Island.

stardrops.source: Stardew Valley Fair: buy for 2,000 star tokens
